lint.name: CAPSULE_MUTEX_VIOLATION
lint.purpose: Enforce 100% lockfree mandate: NO Mutex/RwLock in computational capsules
lint.alternatives: AtomicU64/AtomicU32/AtomicBool (<5ns) | DualAtomicU64 (TOCTOU prevention) | LockfreeHashTable | RingBufferBroadcast (10ns append)
lint.documentation: Complete with Chaos mandate, lockfree alternatives, UCE34 Q33, ASSUM framework

lint.name: CAPSULE_UNALIGNED_VIOLATION
lint.purpose: Detect capsule structs with size not matching alignment (cache line requirement)
lint.triggers: 64B align with 8B size (7 copies share one cache line → false sharing disaster)
lint.rationale: False sharing: 3-5× slowdown | Cache thrashing: unpredictable performance | SIMD safety: ARM/x86 crashes on misaligned loads
lint.documentation: UCE34 Q10 (T1 tier) + Q33 (validation) + B32 (100% cache efficiency) + ASSUM framework

lint.name: CAPSULE_MISSING_GENERATION
lint.purpose: Detect T1 (Atomic) capsules without generation counters (TOCTOU prevention)
lint.triggers: T1 (Atomic) tier capsules without generation counter field
lint.scope: Structs with #[capsule(tier = "Atomic")] or #[derive(ComputationalCapsule)] with AtomicU64 fields
lint.rationale: TOCTOU races: Load value → check condition → value changed (ABA problem) | Two-phase commits require generation tracking | DualAtomicU64 pattern: data(32) | generation(32)

detection.bad: Single AtomicU64 field without generation → TOCTOU race risk

lint.documentation: UCE34 Q10 (tier selection) + Chaos mandate + B32 framework + ASSUM framework

lint.name: CAPSULE_NON_ATOMIC_FIELD
lint.purpose: Detect non-atomic fields in T1 (Atomic) tier computational capsules
lint.triggers: Non-atomic types (u64, u32, bool, etc.) in T1 (Atomic) capsules
lint.allowed-types: AtomicU64, AtomicU32, AtomicU16, AtomicU8, AtomicBool, AtomicPtr | Padding: [u8; N]
lint.forbidden-types: u64, u32, u16, u8, bool, *const T, *mut T (non-atomic variants)
lint.rationale: Data races: Non-atomic fields in coordination structures | Lockfree violation: Defeats entire purpose of T1 capsule | Memory model: Mixed atomic/non-atomic breaks Rust's memory ordering
lint.documentation: UCE34 Q10 + Chaos mandate + ASSUM framework + references (Atomic Capsule.md, KEY_INNOVATIONS.md)
